title: AI System Design
key_concepts: AI system design interview framework: requirements → high-level design → deep dive
Latency optimization: caching, batching, streaming, model selection
Cost optimisation: prompt compression, smaller models, caching strategies
Semantic caching: serving cached results for semantically similar queries
Load balancing across multiple LLM provider keys / regions
expected_skills: Design a scalable AI feature end-to-end in a system design interview
Implement semantic caching to reduce LLM API costs
Apply prompt compression to reduce token usage
Design fallback chains across multiple AI providers
sample_questions: Design a production AI-powered search system that handles 1 million queries per day.
How would you implement semantic caching to reduce LLM API costs by 50%?
How do you handle LLM provider outages? Design a fallback strategy.
What techniques would you use to reduce the p99 latency of an LLM-powered API to under 2 seconds?
